title: Feedback form
notes: `field-sizing: content` grows the textarea to fit what's typed, the auto-resize trick that used to need an `input` listener measuring `scrollHeight` on every keystroke. `:user-valid` and `:user-invalid` add per-field feedback that waits for a real interaction, not just page load.

Honest caveat: the inline messages are `::before` generated content, so they're `aria-hidden` and decorative; the static, always-present hint underneath is what assistive tech actually reads. The dimmed submit button is a visual cue only, real blocking still comes from `required`.
